definitions.gloss: congratulatory gift money, wedding gift money
definitions.explanation: Money given as a gift for celebrations, especially weddings. Typically presented in a special envelope.
A monetary tip given to service workers such as hotel staff or moving workers.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}の{祝儀|しゅうぎ}は{三万円|さんまんえん}が{相場|そうば}だ。
examples.english: The standard wedding gift money is 30,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {祝儀袋|しゅうぎぶくろ}に{新札|しんさつ}を{入|い}れて{持|も}っていく。
examples.english: I'll put new bills in the gift money envelope and bring it.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{祝儀|しゅうぎ}を{渡|わた}した。
examples.english: I gave a tip to the moving company workers.

notes:
USAGE: {祝儀|しゅうぎ} primarily refers to gift money for happy occasions. The amount and presentation follow strict etiquette.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{祝儀袋|しゅうぎぶくろ} (gift money envelope for celebrations)
・ご{祝儀|しゅうぎ} (polite form)
・{祝儀|しゅうぎ}を{渡|わた}す (to give congratulatory money)

ETIQUETTE:
・Use odd numbers (3万, 5万, 7万円) as even numbers can be divided (symbolizing separation)
・Use new, crisp bills
・Use appropriate {祝儀袋|しゅうぎぶくろ} with decorative ties ({水引|みずひき})

OPPOSITE:
・{不祝儀|ぶしゅうぎ}・{香典|こうでん} - money given for funerals/condolences
